T: One toy left. One very long Christmas Eve.
D: A workaholic dad races around the city on Christmas Eve to find the year's must-have action figure.
P: Serve the snacks when Howard hits the toy store on Christmas Eve.
S: the frantic Christmas Eve hunt across Minneapolis
Gingerbread dough rolled thin, cut into little men, baked at 180C for 9 minutes, piped with white icing buttons.
the too-perfect neighbour always popping over
Butter sugar cookies cut into stars and trees, baked at 180C for 8 minutes, iced white and red with sprinkles.
the Christmas parade at the end
Popcorn tossed in white chocolate with red and green sprinkles and a pinch of salt, spread on a tray to set.
M: the family Christmas in the Minnesota cold
Turkey breast brined overnight, roasted at 170C to 70C, rested, with stuffing, mashed potato, cranberry sauce and gravy.
Beef mince and onion in a creamy mushroom sauce, topped with tater tots and cheddar, baked at 200C for 30 minutes until crisp.
W: Dark chocolate spread thin, set, covered with white chocolate and crushed candy canes, set again and broken into shards.
K: Yolks whisked with sugar, hot milk and cream poured in, cooked gently to 75C, chilled, finished with nutmeg and a splash of brandy for the adults.

s.note: the frantic Christmas Eve hunt across Minneapolis
s.how: Melt 125g butter, 100g brown sugar and 120g golden syrup. Stir into 375g flour, 1 tsp bicarbonate of soda and 3 tsp ground ginger with 1 egg. Chill 30 minutes, roll 5mm thick and cut 20 men. Bake at 180C for 9 minutes, cool and pipe buttons with 100g icing sugar mixed with lemon juice.

s.note: the Christmas parade at the end
s.how: Pop 100g kernels and spread on a lined tray. Drizzle with 150g melted white chocolate and toss. Scatter red and green sprinkles and a pinch of flaky salt before it sets. Break into clusters.

m.how: Brown 600g beef mince with an onion and 200g mushrooms. Stir in 250ml cream and simmer until thick. Tip into a dish, cover with 500g frozen tater tots and 100g cheddar and bake at 200C for 30 minutes until crisp.

w.how: Spread 200g melted dark chocolate thin on a lined tray and set. Melt 200g white chocolate with a drop of peppermint extract and spread over. Scatter crushed candy canes, set again and break into shards.

d.how: Whisk 4 yolks with 80g sugar. Pour over 500ml hot milk and 200ml cream, then stir over low heat to 75C. Chill well, grate nutmeg on top and add a splash of brandy to the grown-ups' glasses.
